Kit summary

Viper BiteBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 180% ATK DMG and 180% ATK [Internal Injury] DMG to a single enemy. Afterward, refreshes the duration of all attribute buffs of all allies.
Medicine King's Caduceus Lv.3When Yao Xi's turn ends, he'll cast Viper Bite to pursue and attack 1 random enemy. For every 1 ally with the [Pursue & Attack] tag deployed, reduces all allies' Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 15%. When 5 allies with the [Pursue & Attack] tag are deployed, Yao Xi additionally casts Healing Elixir once.
Healing ElixirActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Restores all allies' HP by 90*Yao Xi's initial SPD and grants them a [Shield] by 270*Yao Xi's initial SPD for 2 turns, up to 2 layers.
Medicine King's Caduceus Lv.2Each time after an ally pursues and attacks, Yao Xi gains [Elixir] and [Electricity Storage]. When [Elixir] is stacked to 10 layers, Yao Xi additionally casts Healing Elixir once; when [Electricity Storage] is stacked to 20 layers, Yao Xi additionally casts Electroshock Therapy once. The effects above can be triggered once respectively before Yao Xi acts in the next turn. Healing Elixir also increases all allies' Turn Meters by 20%. Electroshock Therapy also grants all allies [Internal Injury Up II] for 2 turns.

Benevolent SaviorPassiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases allies' Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG dealt by 0.016% of Yao Xi's initial SPD during a pursue-and-attack, up to 3000 points of SPD can be calculated. When entering a battle, if Yao Xi has more than 1000 points of initial SPD, for every 1 point exceeding 1000, self gains 80 extra points of HP, up to 160000 points can be obtained in this way.
Medicine King's Caduceus Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, increases Yao Xi's Turn Meter by 30%. At the beginning of any turn, if 5 or more enemies' current Tenacity is not lower than 200%, increases all allies' Turn Meters by 30%. This effect can be triggered 10 times in each wave.
